BIOS_Settings.Note_Prefetcher: Disable L1/L2 STREAM HW PREFETCHER when workload is memory constrained.
BIOS_Settings.Note_NPS: Due to the Windows kgroup max of 64 logical processors: If (Cores/Socket <= 32) then set NPS1; If (32 < Cores/Socket <= 64) then set NPS2; IF (64 < Cores/Socket) then set NPS4.

BIOS_Settings.SMT Control: Enabled (if 32 cores or less per server)

BIOS_Settings.Memory Clock Speed: CFD & Other Memory Bound: Auto / Chem, Physics & Other SIMD Bound: Try 1467
BIOS_Settings.Preferred I/O: Enabled if Only One IB NIC

Linux_OS_Settings.Note: For HPC, enable IOMMU in BIOS. Within Linux, add the boot command iommu=pt to set the IOMMU to passthrough mode.
